purpose: Qualify deterministic native perception meshes for the sealed twenty-world corrective topology split before any LiDAR, teacher labels, formal samples or training are produced.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-2 perception-mesh materialization: 20 sealed topology parents (10 corrective-train and 10 corrective-validation), 20 native primary meshes, 20 sanitation audits, 10 train-only complete XY/XZ previews, zero validation previews and zero downstream data/model operations.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly replied '批准' after the exact 20-parent, 10-train plus 10-validation, mesh-only, <=2 CPU-hour and <=1 GiB scope was presented.

source.allowed_use: Local corrective perception-mesh qualification only; not a dataset, teacher, checkpoint or planner input.

sampling.geometry_seed: Use the reserved geometry_seed attached to each selected parent; never draw a new seed.
sampling.mesh_rule: One native primary mesh per parent using the pinned Cano generator and unchanged mesh contract.
sampling.preview_rule: Render complete XY/XZ provenance figures for the ten corrective-train parents only; validation is rendered zero times.
sampling.spatial_spacing: Not applicable to mesh qualification; no trajectory or sensor sampling.
sampling.temporal_spacing: Not applicable to mesh qualification; no trajectory or sensor sampling.

split.selection_or_calibration: No model selection, normalization, threshold calibration, teacher calibration, augmentation tuning or training occurs.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU native mesh generation and sanitation only.

evidence.machine_metrics: 20 parent rows, 20 topology reconstructions, 20 native primary mesh records, 20 sanitation records and exact split counters.
evidence.visual_review: Ten complete XY/XZ figures for corrective-train parents only; no validation preview is produced.
evidence.required_seal: Input parent identities, source files, environment, command, per-parent metrics, previews/provenance, RUN_STATE and output hashes.
evidence.failure_policy: Any source/identity/split/mesh/sanitation/preview/resource mismatch is FAIL and stops the batch. No retry, reselection, alternate mesh, validation rendering, C25 extension or downstream operation.
